GTO Data Change Detection System

A system for maintaining data integrity through automatic change detection and comprehensive documentation.

Example Usage:

```python import pandas as pd from gto.core.setup import install_dependencies

# Install required packages install_dependencies()

# Regular pandas read_csv is automatically monitored df = pd.read_csv(‘my_data.csv’) ```
